title: [UI Tests] Treat warnings as errors in module UI test projects

status.label: Local validation running
status.detail: A single focused validation attempt restored both required projects and compiled the automation library, but the candidate harness did not compile, so no parser contract test ran. Harness-only WinForms ambiguity and generated-file/header issues were separated from unchanged template nullable diagnostics; the latter are not assumed harmless or synthetic. The harness has since been repaired to compile the unchanged parser bodies in isolation, retaining the page-up/page-down, spaced-label and unknown-token cases. Execution of that repaired harness remains pending. The automated review limit is exhausted; no clean review, validated suggestion or author-action proposal is claimed.
